gamerule.simpletpa.auto_accept.descripti: Lets players' /tpautoaccept whitelist and accept-all teleport requesters to them without asking
gamerule.simpletpa.landing_checks.descri: Makes a teleport request wait while the requester could not arrive safely: inside blocks, in lava, fire or powder snow, above a drop that would hurt or the void, or beside a target who is flying or gliding. Turn it off to teleport players there anyway
